system.description: When the force of Gave is called upon, sacred energy erupts from the priest and pierces an undead creature within the ability’s range. Undead struck by this energy receive damage without any chance of avoiding it. Armor does not protect against this ability. Only undead creatures can be harmed by it. The priest directs the energy in the form of a glowing projectile toward a single undead creature within range. The bolt deals 1d10 (OR 8-10) points of damage.
